neighbours.label: the token ' only' in the correlative 'not only ... (but also)'; ' only' meaning 'just' or 'sole' and 'not' with other words stay low
fire: The plan was risky. Not only would it cost millions, it could also fail.
Critics loved the film. Not only was the acting superb, the music was too.
The village is remote. Not only does the bus rarely come, the road floods.
Our new oven is great. Not only does it bake evenly, it also heats fast.
That summer was strange. Not only did it snow in June, the river froze.
She is talented. Not only can she paint, she also writes poetry.
The fix helped. Not only were the crashes gone, the app felt quicker.
He was generous. Not only did he pay the bill, he drove us home.
quiet: The plan was risky. It would only work if the weather held.
Critics loved the film. The acting was superb, and the music too.
The village is remote. The bus comes only twice a week.
Our new oven is great. It is the only one in the shop with a timer.
That summer was strange. It did not rain at all in June.
She is talented. She paints and also writes poetry.
The fix helped. Not all of the crashes were gone, though.
He was generous. He paid the bill and drove us home.
